svg.text: Make sixteen (two poles of eight). Tube 40 x 2 mm, 2,000 mm.

svg.text: Spigot: 35.5 mm tube, 250 mm long, pushed 100 mm into one end

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and fixed with two 5 mm rivets at right angles.
